direct_findings.statement: For A4353 2022–2023, 83 newly visible exact NPI/code/rental rows contribute $3,017,853,044.53; matched rows contribute a $1,592,634.97 increase; exiting rows had $1,259,396.83.
National A4353 reconstructed PUF payment amounts are $40,876,216.24, $3,059,163,823.61 and $1,155,271,517.52 for 2022–2024; supplier detail covers 95.84%, 99.94%, 99.85%.
4,868 of 6,870 supplier rows have blank beneficiary counts. Every row has at least 11 claims. No key duplicates or missing required monetary/service fields observed.

inferences: Magnitude and exact-entry concentration support prioritising the already documented catheter area for reconciliation.
